name: zsh-wordsplit-guard
description: Denies a Bash command containing `for x in $var`: the Bash tool runs zsh, where parameter expansion is not word-split, so the loop silently runs once over the whole string instead of per element. The deny message names the splitting forms to use instead. Opt out per call with `[nosplit]` in the description, or session-wide with ALLOW_ZSH_NOSPLIT=1.
